unlisted_practices: Account for clinician evaluators' attitudinal regard toward medical conditions when using clinician panels to rate LLM-generated patient education.
Evaluate LLM-generated patient education for accessibility, appropriateness, clarity, and completeness rather than technical accuracy alone.
Report divergence between automated and clinician ratings descriptively rather than resolving it through adjudication.
Incorporate direct patient evaluators from target populations to cross-validate clinician proxy assessments of patient-facing accessibility.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint/framework paper proposing a clinician-centered evaluation framework (TAM-MCRS) for large language models in patient education, discussing implications for health system governance and responsible AI deployment.
